instructions: Rewrite short + detail nutshell for humans. Focus on NEW failures: types, areas, and which changes touch the same packages. `changes` are THIS test module's own commits (cannot cause product failures). `qaDeployChanges` are backend/product commits deployed to QA in the window — a QA 500/DB/auth error can be a backend regression from one of these, so evaluate them against the failing endpoints/services before concluding 'infra' or 'not a code regression'. Never invent authors or root causes. Short = overview/Teams (no pass%/duration/build#). Detail = Nightly page (longer). Set source=llm when you rewrite. SCALE LENGTH TO SEVERITY (rulesNutshell.severity): 'none' (green) => headline only, tone=ok, cause=none, causeText one short sentence, investigation='', bullets=[], detail.investigation='', detail.bullets=[]; do NOT manufacture narrative for a clean night. 'low' (a handful of new fails or infra-dominated) => causeText <=1 sentence, investigation <=1 sentence, bullets <=2, detail.investigation <=2 sentences, detail.bullets <=3. 'high' (a real cluster of new non-infra fails) => full write-up (detail.investigation ordered by importance, detail.bullets <=8). Never pad to hit a length. CONTRACT DRIFT (contractDrift.newCount>0) is a SEPARATE lane from test failures: mention it in ONE line even on a green night (endpoints whose response drifted from the OpenAPI contract), but keep it distinct from the test-failure cause; do not conflate the two.
